s1.syndrome_frame: Congenital cutaneous lesions with progressive growth and ulceration, associated with multiple organ involvement and abnormal imaging findings
salient_findings: Multiple cutaneous red papules since birth
Retrognathia, thickened maxillary frenulum, and anterior ankyloglossia
Enhancing exophytic soft tissue polyps in neck and scalp on brain MRI
key_facts: Patient is a 3-month-old boy
Born at full term via spontaneous vaginal delivery
No prenatal care
No history of environmental or hazardous substance exposure
Paternal family history is unremarkable
Maternal family history is unknown
Physical examination reveals numerous bright red macules, papules, and plaques
Many lesions have hemorrhagic crust and dark scale
Normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
Abdominal ultrasonography is normal
Brain MRI shows enhancing nodule along posterior temporal dural surface
Histopathology shows upper dermal lobulated capillary proliferation
Immunohistochemistry results are positive for CD31 and smooth muscle actin (SMA)

shortlist.label: Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Congenital cutaneous lesions with progressive growth and ulceration, associated with multiple organ involvement

shortlist.label: Sturge-Weber syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by congenital facial port-wine stain, often associated with leptomeningeal angiomas and glaucoma

shortlist.label: Parkes Weber syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber syndrome, with arteriovenous malformations and limb hypertrophy

shortlist.label: Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by capillary malformations and arteriovenous malformations, often with progressive growth and ulceration

shortlist.label: CLOVES syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by congenital lipomatous overgrowth, vascular malformations, epidermal nevi, and skeletal abnormalities

raw.rationale: The presence of multiple cutaneous red papules, ulceration, and bleeding, along with the histopathology showing upper dermal lobulated capillary proliferation and immunohistochemistry results positive for CD31 and smooth muscle actin (SMA), are consistent with Parkes Weber syndrome, which is characterized by capillary malformations and arteriovenous malformations.

rejected.label: Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber syndrome
rejected.why: While it involves vascular malformations, the specific combination of findings, especially the presence of enhancing exophytic soft tissue polyps in the neck and scalp, is more suggestive of Parkes Weber syndrome.

rejected.label: Sturge-Weber syndrome
rejected.why: Typically presents with a port-wine stain, which is not described in the vignette, and is associated with leptomeningeal angiomatosis, not explicitly mentioned here.

rejected.label: Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation syndrome
rejected.why: Involves capillary malformations and arteriovenous malformations but the specific constellation of findings, including the presence of multiple cutaneous lesions and the brain MRI results, points more towards Parkes Weber syndrome.

rejected.label: CLOVES syndrome
rejected.why: Characterized by congenital lipomatous overgrowth, vascular malformations, epidermal nevi, scoliosis/skeletal and spinal anomalies, which are not the primary features described in the case.
